Armed mostly carried bludgeons and a smattering of poorly-maintained firearms, the Frostwolves were woefully outclassed. They pulled back to the fortified shopping mall and holed up in one of the stores.\\n\\nIt didn't help.\\n\\nIn the space of twenty minutes, a single blue-scarved figure carrying an antique katana swept through them like the angel of death.
